name: Board
purpose: Columns of cards — kanban, pipeline, review queue.
notFor: Ordered data the user compares — that is Table

anatomy.note: A Menu trigger. Named "Move to… {title}"; the menu is named "Move “{title}” to".

Board.announcement.note: Spoken by the board's live region after a move.

BoardColumn.empty.note: Use a StateBlock with copy specific to the column.

BoardCard.onMove.note: Required for a pointer-free move — WCAG 2.5.1.

keyboard.Enter / Space: On the move button, opens the menu on the first destination.
keyboard.Arrow keys: Move between destinations. Nothing moves yet.
keyboard.Enter: On a destination, moves the card and closes the menu.
keyboard.Escape: Closes the menu without moving; focus returns to the button.

aria.labelling: The move button is named "Move to… {title}", starting with its visible text (WCAG 2.5.3); the menu it opens is named "Move “{title}” to".
aria.focus: The move menu takes focus on open and returns it to the move button on Escape or choice. When the product re-renders the card in its new column the button is removed and focus drops; the announcement says where the card went.
